api_09_plan_roundtrip:
from lazybridge import Plan
def plan_roundtrip(plan): return Plan.from_dict(plan.to_dict())
api_10_checked_run:
from lazybridge import Agent
def checked_run(engine,judge,task): return Agent(engine=engine,name='worker',verify=judge,max_verify=2,max_output_retries=0)(task).text()
api_18_alias_engine:
from lazybridge import CodexEngine
def alias_engine(registry,cwd,client): return CodexEngine(model='gpt-6.1-sol',cwd=cwd,client=client,session_alias='review',session_registry=registry,reasoning_effort='high')
api_20_error_envelope:
from lazybridge import Envelope
def error_envelope(message): return Envelope.error_envelope(ValueError(message),retryable=True)
api_21_task_envelope:
from lazybridge import Envelope
def task_envelope(task,context): return Envelope.from_task(task,context=context)
api_22_clone_tool:
from lazybridge import Tool
def clone_tool(original): return Tool.wrap(original,name='local_measure',description='Local measurement',timeout=0.75)
api_23_schema_tool:
from lazybridge import Tool
def schema_tool(fn,parameters): return Tool.from_schema(name='fetch',description='Fetch data',parameters=parameters,func=fn,strict=True,timeout=1.25)
api_25_native_review:
from lazybridge import CodexEngine
def native_review(thread_id,client): return CodexEngine(thread_id=thread_id,client=client,persist_thread=True,review_target={'type':'uncommittedChanges'},thread_source='benchmark',request_timeout=None,stream_idle_timeout=None)
